tiny_cell_final_record.tours_definition: The number of completed iterations of the transcribed upstream BKZReduction.__call__ while-loop, i.e. the number of bkz.tour(par, 0, -1, tracer) calls that returned. That set is exactly the set of ('tour', i) tracer contexts upstream opens, so it is the number of BKZ tours.
tiny_cell_final_record.tours_why_not_bkz_trace: bkz.trace is None after a default bkz(par) because BKZReduction.__call__ defaults tracer=False and then sets self.trace = None; and even with tracer=True the count exists only AFTER the whole call returns, which is the case a killed cell never reaches. getattr(bkz,'tours',None) is never used: fpylll assigns no such attribute.
